div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Inputs
workbook (.xlsx) · frozen scorecard · optional source documents

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1 · Freeze
read once · SHA-256 of workbook and scorecard
refuse an unfrozen scorecard or an invalid roster
check every sheet the scorecard names exists

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 · Count in code
exact checks give a pass ratio per dimension
bands turn the ratio into a 0-5 score

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 · Rate three blind raters, three model families, in parallel
same prompt · JSON only · 0-5 per dimension · cite a cell

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Citation valid?
sheet and cell exist
quote really in the cell

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Discard the claim
(logged, counted in the report)

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 · Consolidate a fourth model reconciles the three scorecards
merges duplicate findings

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Code enforces the PDF rules
score inside the raters' range
gap over 1 point needs cited evidence
otherwise the lower score stands and a person is asked

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5 · Decide in code
weighted score · critical gates need 4+
human-only evidence supplied?

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
GREEN
moves on once a person confirms

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
AMBER
fix findings, peer review, resubmit

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
RED
back to Discover or Define with a mentor

div.style: color: rgb(236, 236, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6 · Report
eight sections · .xlsx + .md + .json
path to green · full run log in Postgres

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 430px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Re-hash the workbook
abort if it changed mid-run
